html:
On 31 August 1957 the Federation of Malaya became independent from Britain. At Merdeka Stadium in Kuala Lumpur, Prime Minister Tunku Abdul Rahman read the proclamation and led the crowd in seven shouts of Merdeka, freedom.

Independence was won by talks, not war. The Alliance of the Malay, Chinese and Indian parties showed Britain that the races could govern together, while the Emergency was still being fought.

The constitution made Islam the official religion, kept the sultans, with a king chosen in turn from among them, and gave Malays special rights in return for citizenship for many Chinese and Indians. Six years later Malaya grew into Malaysia. See also Malayan Union.
